source_correction.description: Profile paths are canonical logical data/train/<filename> values, independent of physical local or Kaggle mount root.
source_correction.competition_mount_policy: Use /kaggle/input/competitions/rogii-wellbore-geology-prediction directly, with one bounded fallback only if Kaggle changes the mount layout.
source_correction.module_cache_policy: Purge all previously loaded rogii_validation modules and invalidate import caches before importing the extracted runtime package.

runtime_overlay.reason: The sealed dataset-v2 source completed scoring but failed while making the final manifest because artifact_dir was outside the extracted runtime root.
runtime_overlay.application: The notebook verifies the original sealed source hash, decodes the compressed overlay, verifies its byte count and SHA-256, writes it over the extracted source, verifies the written bytes, purges stale modules, and imports the corrected source.
finalization_changes: External OOF paths are relative to artifact_dir rather than runtime root.
Completed outputs can be finalized idempotently without rerunning modeling.
Partial or mixed outputs fail closed on code SHA, data identity, parent hashes, OOF identity, required-file, gzip, and manifest round-trip checks.

notebook.execution_policy: Recover and finalize a complete existing run; otherwise delete partial result/artifact directories and perform one clean full run.

checks: Bundle and input receipt hashes match dataset version 2.
All 30 archive members are unique, safe, extracted, and hash-verified.
Runtime overlay original bytes, decoded bytes, written bytes, size, and SHA-256 are verified.
Competition profile is exactly 773 wells, 5,092,255 total rows, 1,308,266 known rows, and 3,783,989 hidden rows.
Two-thread environment and native thread pools are enforced.
Fresh-run notebook glue passes with artifact_dir outside runtime root.
Completed-output recovery recreates artifact_manifest.json without invoking modeling.
Final output manifest hashes match every archived result and artifact.
ZIP member names are unique and safe.
Packaging before and after recovery is byte-identical.

acceptance: Require status COMPLETE, an execution_mode of full_run or recovered_completed_outputs, all three filenames, exact output download, and independent hash/schema/source review before changing E010's verdict.
